# Fixture — towns

Small, synthetic stand-in for `docs/design/content/towns.md`: a byname table without slugs and a
placement table with one.

## 3. Naming

| Name | Derivation | Reads as |
|---|---|---|
| Vaenern | *vaen* (iron) + *–ern* (agent, non-priestly) | "the iron-worker" |
| Korrern | *korr* (passage) + *–ern* (agent) | "the passage-keeper" |
